story.title: Hiking
paragraphs_en: Last Saturday, it was a bright and sunny day. Ronaldo, Messi and Alison decided to go hiking. After half an hour, they met each other at the entrance of the hiking trail. All three of them were ready and prepared, Alison even brought a drone with him! Soon after they took off. Messi said that he had been hiking on this mountain before and a monkey stole his mosquito repellent! So Messi reminded his friends to be careful about

monkey. They walked and walked staring at amazing sight; green trees covered mountain as a blanket, the branches swaying back and forth when the wind were blowing. There were also some green grass and wild flowers with different colour embellishing the mountain. Bees buzzing and birds chirping; they were enjoying the sight immensely.

Meanwhile, Ronaldo came to a stop. He saw a trail that leads down hill... “I want to explore!” Alison hesitated. “Let’s just keep going.” Ronaldo urged. Soon Alison and Ronaldo broke into an argument. Finally, Messi suggested:

“Let’s just go down and explore, it will be fun!” “Fine!” Grumbled Ronaldo as they hiked down the narrow path. Soon they discovered that there is a lake lying on the valley. Water in the lake were as clear as glass, water flowing smoothly and calmly across the beautiful lake.

Messi suggested they threw rocks and saw who could create the biggest splash... “ KABOOM!” Went Messi’s rock. Suddenly an ENORMOUS fish leaped out of the lake with its mouth wide open. The three friends dashed away as fast as a cheetah.

Soon they stopped out of breath. “Close one.” Alison said in relief. “I never see such thing,” Messi exclaimed in surprise. “I told you not to go down.” Ronaldo pointed out. Later on, three friends were back on trail.

After more hiking and exploring, they decided to take a rest. Messi brought out delicious looking box of home-made cookies. They ate and drunk and then kept walking. After an hour, They arrived a river with a log on it. “ Wow! How in the world are we gonna cross that?” Alison said. Ronaldo took a step on the log and then said:

“mmmm..., friends, I think we can cross the river by stepping carefully on the log.” When Messi walking on the log, he trembled with fear as sweat ran down his forehead, his heart beat faster and faster. The more he felt fear. The more he felt unbalanced. Alison was shivering as one of his foot fell into the water.

Ronaldo looked at them, and said: ”You guys may crouch down and crawl!” They listened to Ronald and done what Ronald said. Finally, They got to the other of shore safely. They continued their journey. After following the trial for a while, t hey saw some monkeys jumping on the tree, and the other people feeding the monkeys with apples. The
monkeys were lovely and friendly. So they decided to protect nature, while they were talking. Alison saw a sign up ahead, it read :END OF TRAIL. What a wonderful adventure!! THE END
